extName.message: For My Privacy: Site Password Lock

extDescription.message: Lock chosen sites and all their subdomains behind a password. It locks again when you step away.

tooManyAttempts.message: Too many wrong tries. Try again in $1.

unlockedNoReturn.message: Unlocked. You can open your site again.

domainsHint.message: Paste any web address. The whole site is locked, including every address under it (like m.example.com).

invalidDomain.message: Enter a site address such as example.com.

permissionDenied.message: Chrome did not allow access to this site, so it was not added.

relatedSuggestion.message: Also lock $1? (another address of the same service)

idleMinutesLabel.message: Minutes without keyboard or mouse input

guardLabel.message: Ask for the password before Chrome's extensions page opens

guardHint.message: Removing the extension from the toolbar menu cannot be blocked.

permissionLostBody.message: Locked sites stay locked, but without site access Chrome may briefly show its blocked page before the lock screen. Grant access again for a smoother lock.

aboutLimits.message: What it protects and what it does not

willLock.message: Will lock $1 and every address under it (like m.$1).

onboardingWelcomeLine1.message: Locks the sites you choose behind a password.

onboardingWelcomeLine2.message: Locks again when you step away from the computer.

onboardingSitesHint.message: Pick the sites you want to lock now. Chrome will then ask you to let this extension see those sites. That is needed to show the lock page instead of the site. Choose Allow. You can change the list later.

onboardingDoneTip.message: All set. Your chosen sites are locked now. Open one in a new tab to see the lock page. To lock again right away later, pin this extension to the toolbar and click its icon, or press $1.

wrongPasswordTries.message: Wrong password. $1 tries left before a short wait.

wrongPasswordLastTry.message: Wrong password. 1 try left before a short wait.

forgotBody.message: A forgotten password cannot be recovered. To start over, remove this extension: click the puzzle-piece icon in the Chrome toolbar, click the three-dot menu next to For My Privacy, and choose "Remove from Chrome". This also erases the password and the list of locked sites. Then install the extension again.

unlockHintAll.message: This unlocks all your locked sites.

unlockHintSite.message: This unlocks only $1 and every address under it.

lockSettingsHint.message: Settings ask for the password again. Locked sites stay locked.

settingsUnlockHint.message: This opens the settings only. Locked sites stay locked.

permissionLostLockedBody.message: Unlock the settings, then open Sites to allow access again.

setupWarningBody.message: If you forget it, the only way back in is to remove the extension and install it again. That also erases your list of locked sites.

onboardingDoneTipEmpty.message: All set. No sites are locked yet. Add one under Sites.

onboardingSkipSetup.message: Skip setup and go to settings

willLockBroader.message: This locks all of $1, not only $2.

domainAlsoLocks.message: and every address under it (like m.$1)

guardHintLink.message: See what it protects and what it does not.

idleClamped.message: Changed to $1 min because the allowed range is 1 to 60 minutes.

popupNotSet.message: Finish the setup in Settings first.

unlockScopeNote.message: Changing this locks your sites again.

unlockScopeSaved.message: Saved. Your sites are locked again.

onboardingDoneTipNoShortcut.message: All set. Your chosen sites are locked now. Open one in a new tab to see the lock page. To lock again right away later, pin this extension to the toolbar and click its icon. You can also set a shortcut key for it at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

unlockNothingToOpen.message: Nothing to open here. Open the site again.

extensionUpdated.message: The extension did not answer. It may have been updated: reload it at chrome://extensions (or reload this page) and try again.
